patch.summary: Freshsales cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Freshsales pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 21-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: Freshsales plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: email sequences, lead scoring, territory management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 21-day trial · Unlocks: forecasting, audit logs · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: Freshsales cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Freshsales against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 21-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB and mid-market teams wanting CRM + phone/email engagement requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.
Side-by-side cost with Pipedrive on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Sales sequences, contact scoring, and territory management start on Pro; forecasting insights, custom modules, sandbox, and audit logs are Enterprise.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Branded documents (list price) and Freddy AI Agent (list price/100 sessions) are listed as paid add-ons.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: SEO copy mentions a free plan, but the live pricing cards researched Aug 2026 list Growth/Pro/Enterprise only starting at list price — treat free forever as unverified from plan cards.

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Sequences, scoring, and territories require Pro

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Forecasting insights and advanced admin are Enterprise-gated

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Freshsales on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model crm spend with Freshsales in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Freshsales alongside category cost modelling.
